profile.headline: Web Developer | Craft CMS Specialist | Content Architect
profile.summary:
🔹 HTML | CSS | Twig | AlpineJS | Tailwind CSS | Amazon S3 | Imgix 🔹
Crafting digital experiences with precision and creativity, I am a versatile web developer with expertise in front-end development, UI/UX design, and content modeling. With a strong foundation in HTML and CSS, coupled with proficiency in Twig templating, I specialize in building dynamic websites and web applications that are both visually stunning and functionally robust.

 Skills Highlights:

•	Content Modeling: Leveraging my expertise in structuring digital content to enhance user experience and streamline backend processes.

•	Front-end Development: Proficient in HTML, HTML5, CSS, CSS3, AlpineJS, and Tailwind CSS, ensuring pixel-perfect designs and seamless user interactions across all platforms.

•	Tool Mastery: Proficient in Gulp.js for task automation, Git for version control, and Twig for templating.

•	CMS Proficiency: Skilled in Craft CMS, Expression Engine, ensuring efficient content management and customization tailored to diverse project needs.

•	E-commerce Expertise: Building robust e-commerce solutions with mobile-first design principles and SEO optimization, driving conversions and revenue.

•	Cloud Infrastructure: Proficient in deploying assets on Amazon S3 and optimizing images with Imgix for lightning-fast loading speeds.

•	Management & Marketing: Strong project management skills coupled with a keen understanding of SEO, social media marketing, and customer service, ensuring projects are delivered on time and exceed expectations.

Objective: Deliver cutting-edge solutions that resonate with audiences and drive business growth.

positions.title: Content Architect, Co-Founder
positions.description:
Led the company's media narrative, leveraging a diverse skill set to deliver coverage of national and international motorsports events. Utilized dynamic storytelling, captivating visuals, and interactive web development to elevate the brand's presence and engagement across digital platforms, resulting in a growth to 50,000+ followers on social media and over 2 million YouTube video views, and including interview of 15-year-old Max Verstappen.

Key Responsibilities and Achievements:
•	Media Coverage: Spearheaded on-site coverage of motorsports events worldwide, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality content across multiple mediums. Captured photographs, produced engaging videos, conducted industry interviews, and crafted compelling articles to enhance the audience's experience.
•	Web Development Expertise: Applied technical expertise in web development to enhance Kart360's online presence, designing and maintaining a user-friendly website that served as a hub for motorsports enthusiasts. Leveraged HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to optimize website performance, implement engaging features, and ensure seamless navigation, contributing to increased traffic and user engagement.
•	Team Collaboration and Leadership: Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to brainstorm ideas, coordinate logistics, and execute multimedia projects with precision and efficiency. Mentored junior team members, providing guidance on best practices in content creation, photography, videography, and web development, fostering a culture of creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement.
•	International Travel and Adaptability: Thrived in dynamic and fast-paced environments, demonstrating adaptability and resilience while traveling to diverse locations to cover motorsports events. Effectively managed logistical challenges, maintained a flexible schedule, and adapted to changing circumstances, ensuring uninterrupted coverage and timely delivery of content to global audiences.

positions.title: Co-Owner
positions.description: Work with clients ranging from drivers to organizations. Responsible for all phases of the project: planning, design, development, launch and beyond.

projects.title: Elevate Property Partnership
projects.description: Web Development Project Lead for a property development company, I spearheaded the creation of a comprehensive website from inception to launch. Through strategic planning, meticulous execution, and innovative solutions, I delivered a user-friendly, visually appealing website that effectively showcased the company's properties and services.

projects.title: Hy-Vee Seasons Digital Experience
projects.description: Directed the development of the Hy-Vee Seasons Digital Experience, an innovative online platform designed to elevate the print magazine's content and foster deeper engagement with Hy-Vee's e-commerce services.
